gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Noto Sans Wancho hits the page like thick chalk pressed hard, with a hulking lowercase and an e left gaping at the terminal. Press Start 2P sits above it, pixel-bright and widely spaced.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-warang-c: Noto Sans Warang Citi packs its words into solid blocks, with wide channels leading into every counter and little fuss. Press Start 2P's pinned-apart letters make it the livelier half.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-yi: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with bowls that look huge. Noto Sans Yi counters with a deep midsection and rounds left unlatched.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: Approachable is the first thing Noto Sans Zanabazar Square says, with a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. Press Start 2P adds its retro swelling curves above.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-traditional-n: Noto Traditional Nushu reads like a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, its bowls filling the line comfortably. Over many lines that fullness stays friendly beneath Press Start 2P.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-numans: Press Start 2P brings fun, retro spacing, each letter pinned apart like a cut-out, while Numans stretches its tracking well past normal. Their shared looseness is the strongest thing here.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-onest: Playful pixels, then quiet curves. Press Start 2P keeps its thick-thin contrast understated, and Onest follows with short ascenders over big bowls that never thin at the shoulders.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-open-sans: Fun comes first from Press Start 2P, whose big open-looking lowercase bowls and widely pinned letters feel playfully retro. Open Sans then gives a smooth read with bulky lowercase and no clogged curves.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-orienta: Retro and spaced out, Press Start 2P pins its letters far apart like cut-outs with big lowercase bowls. And Orienta lets its counters breathe, with little height difference between cases.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-oxygen: Press Start 2P carries a fun, retro feel, with letters pinned far apart and strokes that taper only slightly. And Oxygen answers in sans form, its curves left open and lowercase nearly matching its capitals.
